name: TestGenEval
description: TestGenEval is a large-scale benchmark for evaluating unit test generation and test completion performance of code generation models. It includes 68,647 tests from 1,210 code and test file pairs across 11 Python repositories, covering initial test authoring, test suite completion, and code coverage improvements.
reputation: A recent large-scale benchmark that is gaining attention in code generation research for test generation and completion, but is not yet a long-established community standard.
notes: Highlights challenges in generating high-coverage test suites; best model achieves 35.2% average coverage.
